gaps: rpi-providers pins rpi-plugin-sdk cf4241d2, whose crates/rpi-plugin-sdk/src/dialogs.rs:72 uses Option::is_none_or (stabilized in Rust 1.82). The package therefore fails `cargo +1.78.0 check -p rpi-providers` with E0599 before any provider code is checked. Fixing this needs a package pin bump to a 1.78-clean host revision; pins are outside this lane.

The 1.78 native-loading run mixed a 1.95-built rpi-providers library with 1.78-built Antigravity/Cursor libraries; the C ABI is identical, but a single-toolchain build could not be produced for rpi-providers for the reason above.

Short-vtable coverage uses an allocated prefix of the current PluginApi and the SDK-normalized registration path; it does not include a binary compiled against a genuinely historical SDK struct that predates this repository baseline.

The packaged Cursor worker check asserts manifest shape (catalog, 10 commands, flags, tools, events, auth, runtime, streaming provider) and a clean shutdown, not live Cursor inference or event payload parity; those remain C-lane and R04 work.

Runtime/dist and node_modules needed by the Cursor test are untracked build products. A clean checkout must run the documented npm build/stage commands before setting RPI_TEST_CURSOR_LIBRARY, otherwise registration fails with a clear missing-runtime error.
